title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (5/20): The Lookback Mirror
note_en: 既…也… is the Chinese way to say "both... and..." or, with negatives, "neither... nor...": 这种装置既不能穿越时间，也不能移动位置 "the device could neither travel through time nor move from place to place." English puts the negative into "neither/nor," but Chinese keeps 不 in each half and uses 既 and 也 as the frame. Later the text uses the variant 既…又… for two feelings at once: 既感到温暖又有点害怕 "both warmed and a little frightened."
